NATURE.TITLE: Nature Like You've Never Seen It Before
NATURE.DESC: Be amazed by the speed of the hummingbird, the powerful cry of the howler monkey, the song of the parakeet, and discover endemic fauna and flora as diverse as they are colorful. Thanks to its varied ecosystem, spanning from the Caribbean Sea to the humid tropical rainforest and the mountain páramo, the Sierra Nevada is home to exotic animals and plants that will amaze nature lovers.

ABOUT_PANEL.TITLE: We are the Sierra Nevada
ABOUT_PANEL.P1: We are a tour operator travel agency, registered with RNT 280360, based in the city of Santa Marta, Colombia. We operate with peasant guides in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Trekking to Cerro Kennedy, concessionaires of our main destination. We also run other tourist destinations with Indigenous Communities.
ABOUT_PANEL.P2: Ecotourism and Ethnotourism are our priorities. We carry out sustainable activities, contributing to the economic development of local communities, while maintaining respect for the environment, culture, and traditions.
ABOUT_PANEL.P3: We are a company entirely created by a peasant from the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, who with effort and dedication wanted to showcase part of our Colombian culture to domestic and foreign visitors.
ABOUT_PANEL.SLOGAN: 🌎 The best of Colombia to the world

FOUNDER.TITLE: The heart of Wi Make Tours Santa Elena
FOUNDER.P1: Wimake Tours Santa Elena is a tour operator agency created by the siblings Yuli, Rafa and Alba Rincón Mora together with their mother Ana Rubiela, a family of peasant origin born and raised in Cerro Kennedy, Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta; humble people with a spirit of progress, nature lovers and connoisseurs of the region and its culture.
FOUNDER.P2: This company was born to continue the legacy of our brother Carlos Rincón Mora, a pioneer of tourism in the region, who is no longer in this world, but who with his wisdom and love for his land taught us to value what we have, to have a vision of progress and to share the wonders of the Sierra Nevada, especially Cerro Kennedy, so that others may discover and enjoy it.
FOUNDER.L1: ✅ More than 10 years of experience in adventure tourism
FOUNDER.L2: ✅ Guide certified by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism
FOUNDER.L3: ✅ Official concessionaire operator of Cerro Kennedy
FOUNDER.L4: ✅ Promoter of ecotourism and the indigenous culture of the Kogui, Wiwa, Arhuaco and Kankuamo

HISTORY.TITLE: Our History
HISTORY.P1: Wi Make was born to carry on the dream and legacy of our beloved brother, Carlos Rincón Mora, a pioneer of tourism in our region. Although he is no longer physically with us, his vision, his entrepreneurial spirit and the deep love he felt for the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta remain the inspiration that guides our path.
HISTORY.P2: Carlos taught us that the true wealth of our land lies in its nature, its people and the stories that every corner has to tell. He instilled in us the commitment to protect this paradise and share it with those who wish to live authentic experiences, always with respect for the environment and local communities.
HISTORY.P3: Thanks to his passion, emblematic places such as Cerro Kennedy began to be known and appreciated by travelers from different places. Today we proudly take on the mission of continuing that legacy, opening the doors to new adventures and showing the world the wonders of our region.
HISTORY.P4: At Wi Make we don't just organize trips; we create experiences that come from the heart, we welcome every visitor as part of our family and we work with dedication so that every journey leaves unforgettable memories, inspires love for nature and reveals the essence of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta.
HISTORY.P5: Every journey we make is a tribute to Carlos's vision and an invitation for you to fall in love with this extraordinary land too.

MISION_VISION.MISION_DESC: At WIMAKE TOURS SANTA ELENA our mission is to provide perfect trips where national and international travelers live responsible, different and unforgettable tourism experiences; more than traveling, it is about connecting the soul with the very essence of Colombia's nature and culture, seeking sustainability and care for the environment, working with local communities that know every territory and share our same values of responsibility, thus fostering economic and social development.
MISION_VISION.VISION_DESC: By 2030, to be the leading nature, adventure and ecotourism agency in the Colombian Caribbean, internationally recognized for offering high-quality experiences that revalue the most authentic and remote regions of Colombia. We will stand out for connecting luxury travelers, families and nature lovers with the natural and cultural heritage and local communities in a respectful and sustainable way, generating a positive impact on the conservation of the environment and the development of the territories, while creating unique and unrepeatable memories.
